status: declared/synthetic policy layer (envelope-not-actor); conditions the D3 base weights multiplicatively, never re-derives them
value_semantics: overlay_v(a->b) in [0,1] = given the attacker's action at tactic a came back v (success|failure), the likelihood of b as the next move — 0 = will not happen, 1 = the most likely next course of action. Authored ground-up per directed pair from tactic-pair semantics (kill-chain relationship, capability enablement, foothold dependency) + incident AARs.
composition_rule: at a source place a whose action returned verdict v: w'(a->b) = base(a->b) * overlay_v(a->b) / sum_b'[base(a->b') * overlay_v(a->b')]. The existing (base) edges are manipulated by the verdict; the source place's out-set renormalises so it stays a distribution.
coverage: the WHOLE directed tactic-pair set present in the nets (union across profiles) plus the synthetic-overlay edges — every source tactic, including today's dwell-only ones and resource-development, forward and backward. The action set is extensible: values are authored for the whole space so the policy is ready as verbs are mapped to more tactics. Runtime consumption is gated on verdict availability — a place is conditioned only once a substrate action gives it a success/failure signal (today the six action-bearing places, tactic_action_map.md §4); until then it routes on base weights. Authoring is whole-space; consumption tracks the verbs.
evidence_tiers: success is the more grounded side (the `enables` relations come from MITRE tactic semantics and the get-in/spread patterns the DFIR/Sophos AARs document); failure is declared judgement (incident reports document what worked, not what an attacker does when a step fails). The two sit at different evidential tiers by construction — stated, not hidden.

model.success_rule: enabled -> 1.0; else forward 0.6 / lateral 0.5 / backward 0.25 (0.1 if regressing to a pre-intrusion tactic)
model.failure_rule: gate: initial-access failure -> foothold-dependent dst 0.1; recon failure -> deep dst 0.15, initial-access 0.4; else backward 0.9 / lateral 0.7 / forward 0.3 (0.35 foothold-to-foothold retry-advance)
